change_class_rationale: Adds ProductId, ProductMetadata, ProductEntry, and ProductCatalogError into the existing oya-application-app crate via new product_catalog.rs module. No new crates scaffolded; additive merge-into-existing-crates execution variant. No new workspace dependencies.
task: M02b/P19-application merge-variant delta-1 per user 2026-05-17 (option 2). Smallest net-new types not yet in oya-application-app added via new product_catalog module.
artifacts_touched: crates/oya-application-app/src/product_catalog.rs (NEW; ProductId + ProductMetadata + ProductEntry + ProductCatalogError + 8 unit tests)
local_gates: cargo nextest run -p oya-application-app --all-features: 51/51 PASS (8 new product_catalog tests + 43 pre-existing tests)

findings: ProductId + ProductMetadata + ProductEntry are the smallest viable delta: they encode the product-enablement BC's core value objects (stable routing key, launchpad display data, enabled/disabled catalog row) without importing any new framework or adapter crate.
No new crates, no new workspace deps, no hidden coupling. All types compose purely on std primitives. ProductCatalogError implements std::error::Error — no thiserror/anyhow dependency added.

8 unit tests: ProductId rejects empty/whitespace, ProductId roundtrip (as_str + Display), ProductMetadata rejects empty display_name, ProductMetadata rejects empty subdomain, ProductEntry is_active for enabled/disabled, ProductEntry deep_link_path, filter-only-enabled across 3 entries, ProductId BTreeMap ordering.
All 51 tests pass (8 new + 43 pre-existing). Zero clippy warnings.

ProductEntry.enabled enforces tenant-subscription gating at the value-object layer: callers that filter via is_active() cannot accidentally surface disabled products. No PII fields introduced; no data classification changes required.
deep_link_path() uses only the subdomain field — no cross-BC adapter call. Satisfies LEAN-A2 (kernel types must not call adapters directly).

ProductId is a newtype — O(1) construction, zero heap beyond the String itself. ProductMetadata and ProductEntry compose on std primitives only. No external service calls, no I/O. Horizontally scalable: stateless value objects safe to clone across threads.

ProductId::new rejects empty/whitespace-only strings. ProductMetadata::new rejects empty display_name, empty subdomain, and URL-unsafe subdomain characters (/, ?, #, spaces). No injection surface: deep_link_path() returns a format string over a validated slug.

Constructor functions return Result with typed ProductCatalogError variants — no panic paths in public API. All fields exposed via &str accessors. ProductEntry::is_active() provides a single predicate for filtering. API mirrors codebase patterns established in analogous value objects.

Alternative considered: expose ProductId as type alias String. Rejected — newtypes prevent accidental mixing of product IDs with other string fields at call sites and enable Ord/Hash for BTreeMap keying without wrapping. No framework alternatives introduced.
No secrets or credentials in any field. ProductMetadata::new enforces URL-safe slug invariants, preventing path-injection via deep_link_path(). No unsafe code. No new dependencies introduced.

All type names follow ADR-0056 v4.1 BNF: ProductId (value-object identifier), ProductMetadata (value-object metadata bag), ProductEntry (aggregate root row), ProductCatalogError (error enum). Module name product_catalog matches BC token product-enablement abbreviated to catalog per plan naming section.
Re-export surface: pub use product_catalog::{ProductCatalogError, ProductEntry, ProductId, ProductMetadata} — alphabetical, matches codebase re-export ordering convention.

architect.rationale: ProductId as a newtype over String is the correct abstraction — it prevents accidental string mixing at call sites and derives Ord/Hash for BTreeMap use. ProductMetadata separates display concerns from routing concerns. ProductEntry is the minimal aggregate needed to answer 'which products are active for this tenant' without pulling in TenantProductRegistry (which belongs in a later adapter delta). This is the right layering for a kernel-level value object.

security.rationale: No secrets, no credentials, no network calls, no unsafe code. ProductId::new and ProductMetadata::new reject empty strings defensively. The enabled flag is a boolean gate — callers cannot bypass it silently.
